title: Settlement Timing Rate on Ridgeline Installation Services Final Payments
content:
The timing of the final settlement payment on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract, measured from completion, sets a settlement timing rate.

**Clause.** Settlement timing adjustment on the final settlement payment: the days since completion are the calendar days from the completion date to today; a settlement within the program's final payment due days takes the prompt settlement rate of -0.5 percent, a settlement more than the late-settlement grace days of 30 after the end of that due period takes the late settlement rate of 1.5 percent, and any other settlement takes a rate of 0. The adjustment is that rate applied to the contract price billed, rounded to the cent; it is added to the final settlement payment, and a negative adjustment lowers the payment.

## Final payment due days by program

| Program | Final payment due days | Prompt rate (days since completion) | Rate 0 | Late rate (days since completion) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | 0 | 0 | 1 to 30 | 31 or more |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | 0 | 0 | 1 to 30 | 31 or more |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | 5 | 0 to 5 | 6 to 35 | 36 or more |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | 5 | 0 to 5 | 6 to 35 | 36 or more |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | 5 | 0 to 5 | 6 to 35 | 36 or more |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | 5 | 0 to 5 | 6 to 35 | 36 or more |

A settlement "within" the due days is one made when the days since completion are no more than the program's final payment due days.

## Worked figures (hypothetical contract price billed 8000.00 on a 5-day program)

| Days since completion | Rate | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | -0.5 percent | -40.00, lowering the payment by 40.00 |
| 20 | 0 | 0.00 |
| 35 | 0 | 0.00 |
| 36 | 1.5 percent | 120.00, raising the payment by 120.00 |
